{"path": "/results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_3/brief/sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching_trial_3/quench.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for SiO2 NPT quenching simulation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute temperature
compute mytemp all temp

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# NPT quenching from 5000K to 1500K at 3.5 K/ps
# Temperature change: 3500 K
# Time needed: 3500 / 3.5 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps (with dt=0.001 ps)

# Set initial velocities
velocity all create 5000.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT ensemble with temperature ramp
fix npt_quench all npt temp 5000.0 1500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal

# Run quenching simulation
run 1000000

# Write final structure
write_data final_structure.dat

print "Quenching simulation completed"
"}
